description: NEWS, the Nuclear Events Web-based System, is hosted by the International Atomic Energy Agency and co-sponsored by the OECD Nuclear Energy Agency and the World Association of Nuclear Operators. The site, read on 2026-09-26, lists event reports filed by national authorities with the country, event date, rating on the International Nuclear and Radiological Event Scale (INES), a summary, the reporting body and the date of the last update. Recent entries include INES level 2 radiography overexposures reported by the US NRC and Germany's GRS, a misdelivered radioactive package reported by the UK Office for Nuclear Regulation, and a worker contamination reported by France's ASNR, last updated on 17 September 2026. The event list is public and free to browse with an RSS feed; registration and sign-in exist for other functions, and the site is copyright IAEA with all rights reserved, while content remains the responsibility of the reporting authorities. Caveats: reporting is voluntary by country and many listed events involve radiation sources, not power plants. Simulation uses are frequency and severity inputs for hazard exposure and emergency response planning around nuclear and radiological facilities. Related records: data-nrc-event-notification-reports gives all US licensee notifications.
